query:
-- Senate races with NULL candidates in General/Called/Certified status
SELECT state_code, state_name, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status
FROM senate_races
WHERE status IN ('General','Called','Certified') AND (candidate1_name IS NULL OR candidate2_name IS NULL);

-- Governor races with NULL dem or rep candidate in Voting/Called/Certified status  
SELECT state_code, dem_candidate, rep_candidate, status
FROM governor_races
WHERE status IN ('Voting','Called','Certified') AND (dem_candidate IS NULL OR rep_candidate IS NULL)
LIMIT 20;

-- House races in General/Called with BOTH candidates NULL
SELECT state_code, district, status, candidate1_name, candidate2_name
FROM house_races
WHERE status IN ('General','Called','Certified') AND candidate1_name IS NULL AND candidate2_name IS NULL
LIMIT 20;

-- AP Engine health: count by status for all three tables
SELECT 'senate' as tbl, status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM senate_races GROUP BY status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'house' as tbl, status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM house_races GROUP BY status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'governor' as tbl, status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM governor_races GROUP BY status
ORDER BY tbl, status;
